While a wheel shape exists, the connection to the column is ambiguous and likely structurally unsound upon closer inspection of the driver's hands. The 'Seating' checkpoint is also questionable; the passengers appear to be floating or merged rather than sitting on distinct benches, but the Router marked it present. I agree with the untestable verdicts for occluded parts.

The topology mask shows fragmentation/ghosting near the legs, confirming boundary bleeding. The texture anomaly is minor compared to the structural issues.
